verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a first-party REST API for setting up and scaling pipelines and managing the account programmatically. Its official MCP server exposes read, write and delete scopes over that API, so broad programmatic control is evidenced, but nothing documents full UI parity. One community report calls the APIs unreliable; that speaks to stability rather than coverage, so it is reflected in confidence, not the verdict. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or endpoint inventory showing UI-to-API parity, API coverage for dashboard-centric functions such as Hybrid Deployment Agent and Proxy Agent management, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of complete coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
Copy existing Fivetran connections to a new destination. Keep their configs and schemas intact or modify them as you like.
